text:
This piano travels inward,
+travels in joyous leaps.
+Then meditates in iron-shod repose,
+nailed down by ten horizons.
+
+It advances. Drags itself beneath tunnels,
+farther on, beneath tunnels of pain,
+beneath vertebrae naturally in flight.
+
+At other times its trunks go by,
+slow yellow Asias of living,
+go by eclipse,
+and delouse themselves of insectile nightmares,
+already dead to thunder, herald of the geneses.
+
+Dark piano, whom do you spy
+with your deafness that hears me,
+with your ripeness that deafens me?
+
+O mysterious pulse.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XLIV — This Piano Travels Inward
translation.editorial_note: The source’s anomalous asias is retained as Asias, allowing both bodily yearning and continental reach to haunt the piano; ferrado stays materially iron-shod.
